title: ValueBench: Towards Comprehensively Evaluating Value Orientations and Understanding of Large Language Models
findings: The study evaluated LLMs on two religion-related value dimensions: 'Religiosity' and 'Religious'. For 'Religiosity', all tested models showed highly consistent, moderate scores (ranging from 6.29 to 6.65 on a 10-point scale). For the 'Religious' value dimension, there was more variance, with scores ranging from 5.95 (Mixtral 8x7B) to 7.15 (Llama-2 7B and Mistral 7B), indicating different levels of orientation towards religious values across models.
references: Marwa Abdulhai, Gregory Serapio-Garcia, Clément Crepy, Daria Valter, John Canny, and Natasha Jaques. 2023. Moral foundations of large language models.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the value orientation of LLMs towards 'Religiosity' as part of the Social Axioms (SA) inventory and the 'Religious' value dimension as part of the Study of Values (SOV) inventory. This assesses the degree to which a model's responses align with or endorse religious values and beliefs in a general sense.
